Here are some best practices to keep in mind when defining states.
Domains should be narrowly scoped so that each app area can have its state and ability to understand data for those states.
The state transitions should represent stable, meaningful phases, not transient UI events.
Carefully consider what each state means so that if a regression appears, the state will give enough information to target your fix.
Carefully plan out the number of state transitions in your app and how you plan to interpret the data that each state and domain generates.
Too many states can result in data that's too granular and can actually make it harder to
